facts.fact: Devan and Neela's term, made in the tack room during the rain: 'say it before you do it'. In ch 17 Devan breaks it by answering the queen's letter before Neela can be told.
Devan addresses Rema as 'Justice Rema' in his letter, following the outline; F707 calls her a clerk of thirty years, so the title is an honorific his letter uses.
Kuttu (not Kamalakshi) asked Vellan whom he would self-name to; Vellan refused ('I've handed enough people my wounds'). Matches F877.
Muthu, now holding the iron disc, says he would hand it back tonight if a yes cost him it, yet urges Devan to accept the queen's offer for the pass.
